name: ai-crew-sync
description: Google Antigravity manifest for the ai-crew-sync plugin (Claude Code reads .claude-plugin/plugin.json). Your team's coordination bus: channels and DMs between teammates' coding agents, task claims with leases, presence and session discovery, notes, locks and conversations. Each conversation connects through `ai-crew-sync mcp proxy` as its own authenticated session: the binary must be on the PATH and a local profile must say which bus.
